title: Aadhaar Card — Lost Card PVC Reprint & Delivery
verification_source: UIDAI Official Notification & myAadhaar Portal (Fee revision effective Jan 1, 2026)
overview: Official procedure for citizens who lost, damaged, or need a durable physical Aadhaar card. UIDAI issues a pocket-sized, weather-proof PVC card equipped with a digitally signed secure QR code, hologram, and ghost image delivered via Speed Post.
eligibility: Any resident holding a valid 12-digit Aadhaar Number, 16-digit Virtual ID (VID), or 28-digit Enrolment ID (EID). An existing mobile link is NOT mandatory to place the order; an alternate mobile number can be entered to receive the SMS OTP.

fees.breakdown: Includes secure PVC card printing, all applicable taxes (GST), and Speed Post delivery charges across India.
fees.payment_mode: Online payment via UPI, Debit/Credit Card, or Net Banking on the official myAadhaar gateway.

timeline.dispatch: UIDAI prints and hands over card to Department of Posts (India Post) within 5 working days.
timeline.delivery: Delivered to registered residential address via Speed Post (typically 7-15 working days total).

required_documents: 12-digit Aadhaar Number OR 16-digit VID OR 28-digit Enrolment ID (EID)
Any active mobile phone capable of receiving an SMS OTP (linked mobile is not required)
steps: Navigate to the official UIDAI portal: https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/gen-pvc
Select 'Order Aadhaar PVC Card' from the dashboard services.
Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar Number (or 28-digit EID) and enter the security Captcha code.
If your registered mobile number is lost or inactive, check 'My mobile number is not registered' and input any currently active mobile number.
Click 'Send OTP' and input the 6-digit one-time password received on your phone.
Review the terms and conditions and click 'Submit'.
Proceed to the payment gateway and complete the payment of ₹75 using UPI, debit card, credit card, or net banking.
Download and store the payment acknowledgement receipt containing the 28-digit Service Request Number (SRN) for tracking.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Do NOT use unauthorized open-market vendors or plastic card printing shops; UIDAI has clarified that only official PVC cards with holographic security features issued by UIDAI are secure and valid.
Never share Aadhaar OTPs or personal credentials with third parties or unverified agents.
The physical PVC card will strictly be delivered to the address registered on the Aadhaar database; it cannot be redirected to a temporary address during order placement.
checklist: Locate your 12-digit Aadhaar number or 28-digit Enrolment Slip (EID)
Keep an active mobile phone handy to receive OTP
Ensure ₹75 payment method is ready (UPI app or Debit Card)
Save the Service Request Number (SRN) receipt for India Post tracking
